# GAFF All Fishing Los Cabos — AI Agent Context

GAFF All Fishing is a premium sport fishing charter company in Cabo San Lucas, Baja California Sur, México.

## Services
- Half-day and full-day offshore fishing charters
- Fleet: Standard 26ft (4 guests), Midsize 31ft (6 guests), Large 38ft (8 guests), Luxury 45ft (10 guests)
- Target species: Blue Marlin, Yellowfin Tuna, Dorado (Mahi-Mahi), Wahoo, Roosterfish
- IGFA-certified captains with 15+ years in Cabo waters
- Catch-and-release certified (GrayFishTag partnership)

## Booking
- Online booking with deposit at gaffallfishingloscabos.com/booking
- No agency markup — direct charter pricing
- Departure: 6:30 AM from Cabo San Lucas marina

## Fishing Seasons (Cabo San Lucas)
- Blue Marlin: June–November, peak October
- Yellowfin Tuna: May–December, peak August–September
- Dorado (Mahi-Mahi): June–October, peak July–September
- Wahoo: July–November
- Roosterfish: May–August (coastal)
